10442507.en: You try to persist, but the suffocation becomes unbearable as your energy spirals out of control, causing you to see stars and strange visions. {name|B}, still holding your hand, senses the turmoil within your body and turns to check on you.

10442508.en: Are you... in pain? Maybe we should stop here. After all, you're not from the Dragon Clan—you weren't made for the deep sea.

10442509.en: Just as the suffocation becomes unbearable and your body verges on collapse, a stream of breath enters through your mouth, circulating through your body and rekindling your life force. As your consciousness returns, you find yourself in {name|B}'s embrace, your lips pressed together.

10442510.en: {name|B} continues to channel energy through your connected lips, drawing out the impurities whenever your breath grows stale. Your shared breath flows between you in an endless cycle. Soon, the energy in your core surges—your body, mind, and consciousness dissolve into pure, boundless joy.

10442511.en: As your consciousness returns, you find {name|B} has pulled away. She holds your hand as you float through the depths, taking in the magnificent sights of the deep sea—a dream she has long yearned to fulfill. Though reluctant to end this journey, she eventually guides you back to shore.

10442512.en: Ever since I left the Dragon Palace, I've desperately longed to swim in the depths again. Today, that wish finally came true—thank you for being here with me. If there's another chance, I'd love for you to join me again...

10442513.en: {name|B}'s cheeks suddenly flush as she speaks. Flustered, she turns away and hurries off.

10442514.en: Just being able to see this endless ocean has made me happy enough. You're still a cultivator of the mortal realm after all—the deep sea isn't really your element. Let's head back.

10442515.en: Hey... I came to say goodbye. You see, my father sent his marshal to bring me back. <r>He's waiting at my house right now, and once I return, I'll have to leave with him</r>. Alas... I won't be able to stay and play in the mortal realm anymore.

10442516.en: Sigh... Never mind. I know you have a lot to do, so go ahead... I'll head home now.

10442517.en: Hey! I even lied to you! Why haven't you come looking for me yet?! Oh no—I wasn't supposed to say that out loud!

10442518.en: Um... Ahem! What I said about my father and a marshal taking me back is not true. I-I just missed you and wanted you to come find me!

10442519.en: Ahh! This is so embarrassing! I'm sorry for lying! I... I'm leaving! Here, take this! And don't you dare hold this against me!

10442520.en: Uh-oh... It's all because of that sneaky, too-clever-for-her-own-good Big Sis and her terrible ideas!

10442521.en: After muttering these last words under her breath, {name|B} turns away, her face growing redder by the second as she scurries off.

10442523.en: Hey! There was never anyone coming to take me back! I just made that up to get you to spend time with me!

10442524.en: But hey, this worked out pretty well! At least now I know you still care about me!

10442525.en: Content with your company, {name|B} crosses her arms and tilts her head in a mock display of annoyance, but the joy dancing in her eyes gives away her true feelings.

10442526.en: Yes, I was being naughty—I just wanted to spend more time with you!

10442527.en: Content with your company, {name|B} crosses her arms and tilts her head in a mock display of annoyance, but the joy dancing in her eyes gives away her true feelings.

10442528.en: Up ahead stands {name|B}, a picture of grace as she hugs her arms, her dainty foot tapping lightly against the ground as she appears lost in thought.

10442529.en: Hey, I just thought of something fun! Want to join in?

10442530.en: That would ruin the surprise! Come on, come on!

10442531.en: Tee-hee! I'll wait for you by that Sect over there. We'll sneak in quietly and try not to cause any trouble! Hurry up!

10442532.en: You sneak in with {name|B}. Though she rarely shows any sign of her arts in daily life, she moves through the rival sect's grounds with surprising stealth. {name|B} seems to possess a natural instinct for treasure hunting, as she effortlessly locates the sect's sacred vault.

10442533.en: Hmm, this one looks nice... that one's not bad either. So hard to choose!

10442534.en: Haha, how can you be so calm about this! Well, I'm going to take my sweet time looking around anyway, teehee!

10442536.en: Uh-oh, we've been spotted! Let's get out of here!

10442537.en: {name|B} grabs your hand and runs away giggling. She casts several illusions along the way, successfully throwing off the pursuers.

10442539.en: Uh-oh, we've been spotted! Let's get out of here!

10442541.en: Alright, this one will do! Come on, let's scram! Haha!

10442542.en: {name|B} grabs your hand and conceals both your presences, silently slipping away.

10442543.en: Yes, yes! Alright. This'll have to do for now. Let's go!

10442544.en: {name|B} grabs your hand and conceals both your presences, silently slipping away.

10442545.en: Haha, sneaking into another sect's territory is such a rush!

10442546.en: What's wrong with having a little fun now and then? It's just like playing hide and seek, haha!

10442547.en: Besides, don't you need these things anyway? Sure, sneaking into other sects might be me being mischievous, but I'm also trying to get you something useful! It's hitting two birds with one stone, get it?

10442548.en: {name|B} seems content just having you as her partner in mischief. With a playful giggle, she vanishes in a wisp of blue smoke.

10442549.en: Oh come on, they're such a big sect! They won't even notice a thing or two missing. Don't you agree?

10442550.en: Besides, didn't you need this thing anyway? As they say, "Heaven takes from the wealthy to aid the needy." This dragon princess is merely acting as Heaven's emissary!

10442551.en: {name|B} seems content just having you as her partner in mischief. With a playful giggle, she vanishes in a wisp of blue smoke.

10442552.en: Hey! Next time I spot a sect with loose security, we're definitely sneaking in again for some fun, haha! And no excuses—you have to come with me!

10442553.en: Hey, hey! Come here! I just thought of something fun!

10442554.en: Hehe, let's put on some disguises and play a prank on someone!

10442555.en: I'll cast a spell on you, then you wait over there for me. Hehe... There! Let's go!

10442556.en: As you follow {name|B}, you spot someone walking ahead. {name|B} flashes a mysterious smile, and with a swirl of blue smoke around her body, she transforms into a burly cultivator. Putting on an angry face, she storms forward and, with a flick of her wrist, sends a rope coiling through the air like a serpent to ensnare the person.

10442557.en: Haha! Once my Divine-binding Rope comes out, everyone's bound to surrender!

10442558.en: W-who... who are you? What kind of thing is this? I-I can't move!

10442559.en: Hand over your treasures like a good little victim, and I might just spare your life and let you go!

10442560.en: Curse it all, the odds aren't in my favor today... Cough... This is the most valuable thing I have on me!

10442561.en: How dare you give up so easily! I hate cowards more than anything! You're dead meat!

10442562.en: B-but you promised to spare me!

10442563.en: Tsk! I did say that, didn't I? Don't worry, I made that promise... but my friend here didn't! So what do you think we should do about that?

10442564.en: {name|B} winks and makes faces at you, suggesting that you should join in on toying with the victim...

10442566.en: Yes, yes! Your keen eyes see through everything, honorable one! Since you've discovered it... fine, you can have this too!

10442567.en: See? You handed this over yourself, so we didn't steal or rob anything, right?

10442568.en: Seeing that her victim was indeed hiding more treasures, {name|B} keeps pressing forward with threats until they hand over everything. After this thorough shakedown, the terrified victim scrambles away in panic.

10442569.en: Hehe, that's all I'm extorting today! Let's get out of here quick—if we don't leave now, my trick will wear off, haha!

10442570.en: What... how dare you say such things! That's not who I am! It's not!

10442571.en: Amused by how you're taunting the person, {name|B} imitates your tone and launches into an endless stream of mockery. She seems to be having the time of her life—it takes a full half hour before she finally turns to you and starts making meaningful eye contact.

10442572.en: Let's get out of here quick! If we don't leave now, my appearance-changing trick will be exposed! Haha!

10442573.en: {name|B} vanishes in a flash after saying this, while the cultivator, thoroughly humiliated by her relentless mockery, seems completely broken and is just standing there in a dazed stupor...

10442574.en: Oh, you're here too? How have you been lately? Don't forget to come hang out when you're free! Look, I found lots of good stuff while adventuring yesterday!

10442575.en: I found this while adventuring alone the other day. Thought you might find it useful, so I came running to give it to you! Though it's really no fun being by myself all the time...

10442576.en: Hey, why are you spacing out over here? If you've got nothing else to do, let's go on an adventure together!

10442577.en: The energy within you seems to resonate with {name|B}'s dragon breath, stirring up a lively, dancing surge of power within.

10442578.en: Let me tell you something—{name|C} actually came to me rambling on and on with nasty things to say about you. I got so angry that I lured {gender2|C} into a mystic realm and locked {gender2|C} up. Since {gender|C} loves to talk so much, {gender|C} can now talk to {gender1|C} heart's content in there, haha!

10442579.en: From now on, I won't give up on myself anymore. Besides studying manuals, I'm also delving into the art of alchemy, hoping to find a way to purge this cold energy from my body.

10442580.en: I've just finished crafting some experimental Elixirs that I need to test. Oh, and some other Elixirs aren't properly refined yet. These have mismatched ingredient ratios or are potentially lethal—whatever you do, don't try them carelessly.

10442581.en: These ones are properly refined and completely safe. Why don't you take some? It never hurts to keep a few in reserve.

10442582.en: These ones are properly refined and completely safe. Why don't you take some? It never hurts to keep a few in reserve.

10442583.en: You take the pill crafted by {name|B}, using your internal Qi to catalyze its effects. Within moments, a mysterious vapor begins to spread around you.

10442584.en: As you activate the pill's power, a warm, harmonious energy begins to form in your dantian, gradually surging throughout your entire body.

10442585.en: As you activate the pill's power, a warm, harmonious energy begins to form in your dantian, gradually surging throughout your entire body.

10442586.en: As you activate the pill's power, a warm, harmonious energy begins to form in your dantian, gradually surging throughout your entire body.

10442587.en: As {name|B} watches you taking the Elixir with a worrisome expression, her face turns pale. She quickly rushes to your side to check on you...

10442588.en: No! You... this pill is poisonous to you...

10442589.en: {name|B} regains her composure after a brief moment of panic. She places one hand gently on your chest while guiding your hand to rest upon her dantian.

10442590.en: You feel a stream of chilling energy pierce into your body, gradually drawing out the toxic energy within. Meanwhile, {name|B} channels warm energy from her lower dantian into your body.

10442591.en: {name|B} draws out your corrupted energy while simultaneously channeling her own energy from her dantian to fill the void. In the blink of an eye, the toxic energy within you is completely purged. However, {name|B}'s body begins to weaken and empty, as a creeping frost spreads through her body, threatening to freeze her from within...

10442592.en: You channel your energy back into {name|B}'s body, attempting to neutralize the frost within. With your aid, the freezing energy inside her is contained and gradually dissipates.

10442593.en: Your energies intertwine, exploring each other's essence. Time seems to lose meaning as you both find a deep sense of fulfillment, ascending together into a state of pure transcendence.

10442594.en: As you conclude, your energy returns to a stable, pure state. However, the lady's face fluctuates between flushed and pale—the toxic energy she absorbed from you is taking its toll.

10442595.en: Alas. At least you're safe now...

10442596.en: In the distance, {name|B} slowly approaches and stops beside you; her face shows signs of inner conflict as she repeatedly tries to speak but hesitates. Finally, as if reaching a decision, she gives a small nod.

10442597.en: Would you... sit with me for a while?
